# Danish Saini — UX/UI Designer & Frontend Developer

> Portfolio of Danish Saini, a UX/UI designer and frontend developer based in
> Dubai, currently completing a BSc in Computer Science at De Montfort
> University Dubai. He designs interfaces, builds them in React, and writes
> books.

## Pages

- [Home](https://danishsaini.com/): Introduction, featured projects, and contact details
- [About](https://danishsaini.com/about): Journey across India, Canada, and the UAE; skills, experience, education, and certifications
- [Projects](https://danishsaini.com/projects): Selected design and development work
- [Contact](https://danishsaini.com/contact): Email and social links

## Projects

- [LearningZone Redesign](https://danishsaini.com/projects/learningzone): UX case study — redesigning a university learning platform
- [FindMyTutor](https://danishsaini.com/projects/findmytutor): End-to-end UX design project, research to hi-fi prototype
- [Little Lemon Restaurant](https://danishsaini.com/projects/littlelemon): Multi-page React web app with menu, reservations, and cart

## Books

- [Books](https://danishsaini.com/books): Published writing
- [The Foreign Land](https://danishsaini.com/books/the-foreign-land): A memoir about leaving India for Canada at nineteen
